gaps.title: Assemble, install and maintain temporary LV electrical panels (distribution boards) at construction site

pcs.text: read relevant SLDs(Single Line Diagrams), instructions, safety guidelines, manufacturers specifications prior to assembling temporary panel/ distribution boards
place and secure the distribution board against external damaging agents like water, fire etc
carry out earthing of the panels as per standard procedure
respond promptly to failure/ damage or malfunctioning of panel or any of its components
carry out necessary tests in order to determine root cause of failure
notify concerned authorities prior to shut down, deactivation or repair of the electrical unit
replace/ repair faulty components as per SLD, instructions, safety guidelines and manufacturers specifications
document and keep records relevant to maintenance/ repair of panels as per organizational norms
isolate the panel safely and shift to another location as per requirement

gaps.title: Install temporary lighting arrangement at construction sites

pcs.text: check cable, conduits , lights, sockets, temporary power distribution panels at power source and other required fixtures and accessories as per manufacturers guidelines and specification
select the type and wattage of lights considering illumination requirement at worksite and install them at secured positions
tag embedded, exposed electrical lines and other key equipment appropriately
carry out relevant tests to trace out power interruptions/ continuity at lighting arrangements
replace damaged cable, other relevant parts as and when necessary
replace faulty circuit breakers, fuses, switches, electrical and electronic components and wire as per requirement
perform preventive maintenance on diesel generators at site provided for temporary lighting (if any) at scheduled intervals as per direction of concerned authority

gaps.title: Assist in LV (Low Voltage) electrical wiring at permanent structures

pcs.text: read and interpret single phase LV wiring diagram
test electrical circuit during and post wiring activity using appropriate tools as per direction of electrician
assist in carrying out electrical earthing work by installing earthing components as per instructions

gaps.title: Work according to personal health, safety and environment protocols at construction site
